mu_name_from: The Dungeon's object slot 42, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123).
sheet_from: Data/Object2/, from MuMain, decoded under a dn_ prefix: assets/textures is one flat pool, and wood01 and TileRock01 are other worlds' names too. TileRock01 is byte for byte World2's own, so the rocks wear the ground's copy.
why_this_one: The standing torch, 1.66 m, 56 of them.
material_note: wood01 is an atlas of wheels, crates and planks; the torch brackets take timber.
additive_from: A departure, as Lorencia's FireLight01 and 02 are. The client gives the Dungeon no blend mesh (ZzzObject.cpp CreateObject has no WD_1DUNGEON arm) because CreateFire's particles hide the painted flame; fire0a is flame on black, and drawn opaque it is a black card, so it is added.
emitters_from: MoveObject's WD_1DUNGEON arm, ZzzObject.cpp:3890-3892: CreateFire(0, o, 0, 0, 190), the same fire as Lorencia's braziers -- luminance 0.6 to 1.1 weighted (L, 0.6L, 0.4L), four tiles of reach, eased to 3 Hz as theirs are.
